_comment: Two identical Spearmen lines face an identical cavalry charge. The right line (uid 1) is ordered to Brace early and settles well before contact; the left line (uid 0) is left at the no-order default, which holds formation rather than auto-advancing. Both lines therefore wait in place; the cavalry covers the full gap. Demonstrates the graded soldier_brace() formula: the braced line holds its ground on impact, while the unbraced line is driven back. max_frames is 320 (640 physics ticks at fixed_fps 30) so both charges land -- the left-hand pair only meets around tick 520, and the clip needs that window to show the knockback contrast. World coordinates; physics ticks (60/s).
